description: Look up eBay seller feedback and reputation stats by seller username or store URL, optionally filtered by rating type.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of feedback rows to return, across all requested sellers combined.
maxItems.title: Max items

sellerUsernames.description: eBay seller usernames to fetch feedback for, e.g. "musicmagpie". At least one of sellerUsernames or storeUrls must be given.
sellerUsernames.title: Seller usernames

storeUrls.description: Full eBay store URLs (https://www.ebay.com/str/<seller>) — resolved to the same seller's feedback page. Accepted as an alternative or supplement to sellerUsernames.
storeUrls.title: Store URLs

title: eBay Seller Feedback Scraper Input
